verdict: NEGATIVE. Cutting trainable capacity does not close the generalization gap; it lowers the peak instead.

hypothesis_tested.claim: The diagnosed bottleneck is a generalization gap (BOTTLENECK_DIAGNOSIS_20260806.json: the architecture fits 48 unaugmented cases to 0.885 while 972-case validation sits far lower). Reducing trainable capacity from a full image-encoder unfreeze to the last four blocks should therefore raise validation DSC.
hypothesis_tested.single_factor: unfreeze policy full -> last4; trainable parameters 100,509,232 -> 35,951,920 (a 64% cut)
hypothesis_tested.geometry: gt_crop, i.e. the stage-2 refiner geometry, identical cache to the reference arm

result_validation_108_3_clicks.conclusion: The loss is statistically clear: the CI excludes zero and 79 of 108 cases got worse.

what_the_capacity_cut_DID_do.reading: Overfitting was genuinely reduced -- the gap shrank by 38%. But validation fell
with it. The 64% of parameters that were frozen were therefore not pure
overfitting capacity: a meaningful part of them was doing useful work.
Less overfitting is not the same as better generalization.

second_finding_lr_annealing_is_inert_her.observation: This arm annealed at epoch 60 (encoder 1e-4 -> 1e-5, head 1e-5 -> 1e-6) and
produced no new high in the 24 epochs that followed; its best was epoch 24,
long before the milestone. The gt_crop full-unfreeze arm behaved identically:
milestones [60, 90] both fired and its best was epoch 48, before either.
second_finding_lr_annealing_is_inert_her.conclusion: Two independent arms now show that LR annealing produces no new validation high
on this task. An earlier estimate in this project that annealing was worth
second_finding_lr_annealing_is_inert_her.caveat: This does not generalise to the braincrop geometry, where annealing was never
actually reached (early stopping at epoch 118 preceded milestone 120). That arm's
schedule remains untested rather than shown inert.

agent_prediction_record.registered_before_the_run: uncertain; stated to the operator that 'last4 might also lose -- cutting capacity is double-edged and I have no confidence either way'
agent_prediction_record.note: The uncertainty was stated honestly in advance rather than after the fact.

implications: The generalization gap is NOT addressable by shrinking the model. Remaining levers are ones that add information or vary the data: more training subjects, stronger or better-matched augmentation, multi-modal input, or cross-validated use of the full 1080 outer-train split.

Capacity-reduction variants (LoRA, deeper partial freezes, adapters) are now a priori less attractive: this project has tested LoRA, rank-0, last-4 partial unfreeze and now last-4 at the stage-2 geometry, and full unfreeze has beaten every one of them.
LR schedule tuning is deprioritised: shown inert on two arms.
no_test_data_was_read: This arm trained, selected and was evaluated entirely on the 972/108 split. The 270-case test was not opened.
